meta.provinceField: 2027 records use their own province field; city mapping is not a province fallback.
meta.cityFilterRule: A 2027 record is assigned to a city only when its city field is a canonical single city and its location text does not list multiple cities or a province-wide scope.
calculationNotes: Plan values are lower-bound sums from non-overlapping annual rows; a city rollup is preferred where supplied, otherwise audited area rows are used.
Unknown numeric plans remain null; explicit zero remains zero.
Actual bachelor nominees are deduplicated by evidence content and kept separate from planned positions and bachelor access.
Each main-table row contributes only its primarySourceGrade to source-grade counts.
Competition counts separate actual registration counts from rule-only evidence; no registration totals are estimated.
Nine-dimension values are taken from current city metric dimension scores and the overall mean is recomputed from the nine displayed dimensions.
